mapper.select: SELECT symbol, current_price, high_price, low_price, last_updated FROM market_prices ORDER BY symbol ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_prices (symbol, current_price, high_price, low_price, last_updated) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{currentPrice}, #{highPrice}, #{lowPrice}, #{lastUpdated}) ON CONFLICT (symbol) DO UPDATE SET current_price = #{currentPrice}, high_price = #{highPrice}, low_price = #{lowPrice}, last_updated = #{lastUpdated}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM market_prices WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
